data_description.exposed_entities: Type part of the name (e.g. "kitchen") and click the device in the list that appears — it is added below. Repeat to add more: the list keeps them all, and you can drag to reorder. Typing alone does not add anything.
data_description.report_state: When on, Alexa is notified of changes made at the wall switch or by automation, and the app state stays current. Requires re-linking the skill with 'Send Events' enabled in the Amazon console.
